style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

A term used in the names of ⟦0⟧, also informally to refer to a tactical formation of one or more regiments and other assets, a tactical force of comparable size, a collection of varied troops grouped together, or other colloquial meanings. To avoid confusion, it should not be used interchangeably with "regiment" to describe a combat ⟦1⟧ column in a ⟦2⟧. Infantry - This word standing alone may refer to either the general category of infantry soldiers (those using ⟦0⟧) or specifically to non-specialized combat infantrymen who travel on foot, as distinguished from ⟦1⟧ (⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, and ⟦4⟧) and from mounted infantry (⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧, and ⟦7⟧).

⟦0⟧. An agreement or formal treaty between countries not to attack one another via a ⟦1⟧ (DOW).

Here are some of the common slang terms in the game and in discussions surrounding it:

⟦0⟧: Dedicated player who focuses their attention on micromanaging ⟦1⟧ for their ⟦2⟧ and tries to obtain strong bonuses to their air units through ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ choices. Very common in multiplayer games.
⟦0⟧: In multiplayer, similar to an air controller, but as a player playing co-operatively for a nation that is not 100% dedicated to managing ⟦1⟧.

⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧: In multiplayer, an Axis strategy that invests a lot into the faction's air force, usually also forcing the Allied faction to invest similarly large amounts into their airforce to match the Axis. Referred to as a "gamble" or "casino" because of its highly variable results, sometimes being very strong (because it can fully prevent any allied naval invasions) and other times being very weak (because it leaves insufficient production for land units, particularly tanks) depending on how the rest of the game progresses.

⟦0⟧: A ⟦1⟧ that is meant to have very high armor and that is meant to be used by a single battalion in a tank division that otherwise has more economical tanks that do not focus as much on armor. Related to the Space Marine, but is more effective at its job of providing more armor to a division for as little extra cost and stats reductions as possible.
⟦0⟧: A strategy, usually in multiplayer, where the Allies, mainly the ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, prioritize fighting ⟦3⟧ in Asia instead of the Axis powers in Europe and Africa.
⟦0⟧: A shortening of "Operation Barbarossa", used to describe the German invasion of the USSR/Russia.
⟦0⟧: A large nation that tends to get larger over time unless checked. Named after how such large nations' expansions can leave them with irregular borders, resembling blobs of paint.
